title: Natural tensor stalk transport of an affine tilde model
statement: Let i:Z→Y be any scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], V⊆Z open, z∈V, U affine containing i(z). Put A=O_Y(U), R=O_V,z [def-pc-module-stalk-functor] with A-algebra map the germ at i(z) followed by the two scheme stalk maps. Let T be tilde followed by affine chart restriction. There is a family τ indexed by every O_Y-module F, A-module M, and sheaf isomorphism e:F|_U≅T(M), identifying the stalk at z of F tensor-pulled back along i and restricted to V [def-pc-module-pullback] with R⊗_A M. The family is natural: whenever c:F→G and d:M→N satisfy c|_U≫eG=eF≫T(d), τG sends the pulled-back stalk map of c to the scalar extension of d applied after τF. No derived, Koszul, closed immersion, coherence, flatness or finiteness hypothesis is imposed. Sheaf modules are [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]; T uses the associated-module functor whose sections on principal opens are localization [lem-weil-pbc-spec-module-tilde-sections].

proof.text: Apply the natural restricted pullback stalk comparison β and the natural affine model stalk tensor transport γ. Define τ(F,M,e) as the additive equivalence β(F) followed by γ(F,M,e). Rewrite with the naturality law for β, then apply the naturality law for γ to the given affine square.

theorem exists_affine_model_tensorPullback_stalk
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y) (V : Z.Opens) (z : V.toScheme)
    (U : Y.affineOpens) (hzU : i z.1 ∈ U.1) :
    let A := (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u)
    let R := (V.toScheme.presheaf.stalk z : Type u)
    let ρ : A →+* R := ((Y.presheaf.germ U.1 (i z.1) hzU) ≫
      i.stalkMap z.1 ≫ V.ι.stalkMap z).hom
    letI : Algebra A R := ρ.toAlgebra
    let T := tilde.functor Γ(Y, U.1) ⋙ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.isoSpec.hom
    ∃ τ : ∀ (F : Y.Modules) (M : ModuleCat.{u} A),
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.1.ι).obj F ≅ T.obj M) →
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj F)).presheaf.stalk z ≃+ R ⊗[A] M,
      ∀ (F G : Y.Modules) (M N : ModuleCat.{u} A) (c : F ⟶ G) (d : M ⟶ N)
        (eF : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.1.ι).obj F ≅ T.obj M)
        (eG : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.1.ι).obj G ≅ T.obj N),
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.1.ι).map c ≫ eG.hom = eF.hom ≫ T.map d →
        ∀ x, τ G N eG
          (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).map
            ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).map c)).stalkLinearMap z x) =
          d.hom.baseChange R (τ F M eF x)
